title: hieracium ammobium subsp. senile
intro: Hieracium ammobium subsp. senile, commonly known as old man's hay, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health issues. The health benefits of Hieracium ammobium subsp. senile include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects.
